summary.text: Yellow Flowers Thinning Life is Wan Zi Hong's wood path immortal killer move and trump card. It thins the body and can shrink lifespan.

claims.text: While Thousand Transformations Ancestor fights Xing Ye Wang and Prince Feng Xian, Wan Zi Hong points her finger and activates yellow flowers thinning life. He shivers, his expression changes intensely, his body thins, and his lifespan shrinks rapidly. He tries many transformations but cannot break it and can only retreat. Xing Ye Wang and Prince Feng Xian chase him. He has Myriad Statue Palace take them on, and Myriad Transformations Ancestor comes to help.

Wan Zi Hong then uses yellow flowers thinning life on Myriad Transformations Ancestor. That body also thins rapidly, and speed and strength both fall. He is essentially an Immortal Gu House and has no lifespan, so although he looks miserable, it is not a big issue. Thousand Transformations Ancestor cannot break the killer move. After repeated attempts he finds some transformations that delay the effect, but then he cannot transform casually and his battle strength is greatly restrained.

After using yellow flowers thinning life twice in succession, Wan Zi Hong’s face becomes extremely pale. For some time she does not continue her attack and only pants heavily. The two casts put an extreme strain on her, and the risks are high. If Wei Feng had not died, she would not have used such a risky battle tactic.
